citations.title: Flood Endorsement (2023 set)
citations.excerpt: Damage to the insured vehicle caused by flood or rising water is an insured peril and is paid up to the flood Sub-limit. EXCLUDED: damage where the driver drove the vehicle into or through standing water deeper than the wheel hubs, including engine damage from water ingress. Flood damage to a parked vehicle is not excluded.

fnol_redacted: Claim [ID_REDACTED]. My car was damaged in the flood on 2025-01-13. I drove through standing water on the road and the engine stopped.  This is [NAME], living at [ADDRESS], phone [PHONE].
summary: The loss occurred on 2025-01-13 while the policy was in force (2024-05-20 to 2025-05-19) under the 2023 wording set. The relevant wording is MOTOR cl.5.3 - MOT-END-FLD-2023, which contains the flood exclusion clause, and the financial figures are a deductible of INR 5,000, a flood sub-limit of INR 150,000 and a total policy limit of INR 1,200,000. This case has been referred to an adjuster for further review.
